relevance.justification: All messages were strictly focused on the task of fetching, cutting, and assembling the salad ingredients.

clarity.justification: Messages were highly unambiguous, clearly stating current locations, inventory contents, and required next steps.

grounding.justification: Agents accurately reported their inventory contents, but Robot_1 repeatedly asked Robot_3 to come to the Food assembly table when Robot_3 was already there.

coordination_utility.justification: While agents successfully discovered who had which ingredients, they failed to coordinate dropping the items onto the assembly table, leading to resource conflicts and task failure.

redundancy.justification: Communication was mostly concise, though there was minor repetition when Robot_1 repeatedly asked Robot_3 to come to the assembly table.

planning_coherence.justification: Agents understood the high-level dependencies (cut before assemble), but their low-level planning was flawed as they repeatedly attempted to ASSEMBLE while ingredients were still in their inventories rather than on the table.

failure_explanation_quality.justification: After multiple ASSEMBLE failures, Robot_3 correctly diagnosed the issue at the very end of the episode, explicitly instructing Robot_1 to drop the cut tomato on the table to allow assembly.
